source.rule: MONIT=Y stores PM counters with each item individual. Item PM and system PM are distinct PMID tasks; the first counter reaching its own interval starts its task. Stocked item starts with zero age absent Prelife. MNOCC=1 permits one SYS-SWAP occurrence from simulation start. Scheduled removed items go to local overhaul and return to stock.

hypothesis_before_native.common: First two-hour mission triggers one-time SYS-SWAP at hour 10, removes the initially installed item, takes the stocked spare, overhauls the removed item and returns it to stock.
hypothesis_before_native.monitored: The zero-age former spare accrues two operation hours by hour 22, below item PMINT=3, and four by hour 34, above it. LRU-OP3 therefore first triggers on that same physical item at hour 34, taking the overhauled original from stock.
hypothesis_before_native.system-converted: With MONIT=N, LRU-OP3 uses a system-level counter. If SYS-SWAP does not reset this separate PMID counter, it reaches four total operation hours at hour 22 and triggers then, while the monitored item arm does not.

predeclared_native_acceptance: Both arms must exactly roundtrip authored tables, calculate with zero conversion errors, valid nonempty event/report output, and no incomplete PM runtime warning.

The fixed three mission events, all system/item PM starts and completions, physical item IDs, stock issues/returns, and terminal state must be reconciled per arm from native events and aligned report bins.

The hypothesized timing contrast must be observed before using this as evidence for zero-age item counter behavior or reinstallation. If timing is equal or another task intervenes, restrict or reject the claimed scope.
A separate read-only reviewer must replay frozen input and raw evidence without importing the author implementation.
limits: This is one item, one stock position, one seed, one scheduled system swap, one item PM interval, and zero implicit initial age; it does not establish general PM counter laws or prelife.
Counter age is inferred from isolated PM timing and item identities if observed; no direct per-item counter report is available.
GUI visual content and cross-engine equivalence remain unverified.
